notes.title: Aeon Drive Update #3: Major overhaul to player mobility + bug fixes
notes.content:
We meet again, Neo Barcelona visitors!

A [b]new patch[/b] just went live featuring several [b]bug fixes[/b] and improvements to the [b]mobility[/b] and [b]responsiveness[/b]. This patch was created with the help of our speedrunning community feedback, so the game should feel and play better than ever!


[u]Here’s a list of the main changes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Time will no longer stop when pausing on respawn
[*] Jack will no longer face a different direction when attacking/throwing dagger while idle
[*] Levels beat using wall glitches will no longer count towards the leaderboards
[*] Fixed landing animation delay and input bug
[*] Fixed bug that prevented players from teleporting to the dagger while slashing
[*] Added input buffers
[*] Ground pound animation can now be canceled
[*] Wall jump is improved and should feel more responsive now
[*] Grabbing a diamond while in co-op mode will now correctly show in the level report
[*] Fixed bug that would show all save slots with 100% collectibles unlocked
[*] Fixed end of tutorial game crash
[*] Added button remap localization
[*] Overall polish of animations and inputs
[/list]
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/XS9l422RUqz5OtqUG1/giphy.gif?cid=790b76110c9290fe6aeb8412a60ce3dbffdb5dbec95aa446&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

As always, thank you for all the support that you have shown, and we hope you continue to have fun with Aeon Drive.

For feedback and/or bug reports, feel free to join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/K955a5nt5j]Discord[/url][/b].

[url=https://discord.gg/K955a5nt5j][img]https://i.imgur.com/icHFk6n.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Aeon Drive Update: Bug fixes + improvements
notes.content:
Hello Neo Barcelona visitors!

A [b]new patch[/b] just went live featuring [b]bug fixes[/b] and [b]general improvements[/b] to the UI, menus and gameplay. 


[u]Here’s a list of the main changes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Collectible information (gems, hotdogs, data cubes and number of time capsules used) will now correctly display on the save slot, sector selection and level section.
[*] Tutorial improvements.
[*] Confirmation step when deleting a save slot.
[*] Twitter video replay sharing system re-implemented.
[*] More options: disabling vibration, screenshake and countdown at the start of a level.
[*] Remapping is no longer in playerprefs (this will solve the crashing issues some players were experiencing).
[*] In-game bug fixes: fixed camera boundaries, fixed the bug where sliding and pausing the game would cause the timer to stop.
[/list]

notes.title: Check out the story prequel to Aeon Drive: Try Dimension Drive out for FREE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38356345/f5540622507d6c396ad891d6d06b8eeca2f9075a.png[/img]

[h3]Did you know Aeon Drive actually has a prequel game?
[/h3]

Go back to the origins of Aeon Drive’s universe with Dimension Drive, a mind-bending shoot-em-up which will have you hop between two dimensions in real time!

In Dimension Drive, the warmongering race of Ashajuls set its sights on the whole Universe, which triggered a full-scale war that left no one unscathed. However, even keeping most of the Universe under his thumb couldn't sate the hunger of the supreme leader Nies. Gadgets called Dimension Drives have then been invented to expand into other dimensions and fan the flames of a never-ending multi-dimensional war. As the last survivor of your race, it is your job to master dimension-hopping and put a stop to the bloodshed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38356345/82156c651facdc7379600e4661f415daf124391b.gif[/img]

Blast your enemies, collect power-ups, and master hopping between two dimensions to keep yourself out of trouble. This old-school shoot-em-up with a new gameplay twist will test your body and mind and throw you into a battle of galactic proportions, which kickstarted the Drive universe!

[h3]While you’re waiting for Aeon Drive’s release, check out this prequel story for FREE from June 3 through June 7.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/394430/Dimension_Drive/

notes.title: Aeon Drive in a nutshell
notes.content:
Aeon Drive is a speedrun action platformer set in a Cyberpunk Barcelona. 

The player controls Jackelyne, a stranded space pilot on a quest to retrieve faulty pieces of dimension-bending machinery in order to preserve the space-time fabric of the universe. 

Jack will have to overcome a myriad obstacles using her sword, her teleportation dagger, and her unique skill to control time.

Aeon Drive´s alpha demo has the below key features:

- 11 levels across 4 different cities 
- Unique teleportation mechanic that encourages speedrun
- Eye-catching quality synthwave pixel art style.
- Real-time difficulty adjustment in the hands of the player : play as a Pro or casually stroll around the city.
- Discord, Twitter and leaderboard competition perfect for Streamers
- Strong replayability with levels designed to have multiple routes that can be discovered depending on player skill.
- Non-linear level design in collaboration with community speedrunners.
